messages:
maria: Heads up  post-launch round: we need to decide on backlog grooming cadence. My suggestion: two sprints of 70% bugs / 30% enhancements, with a policy for <2-3 hour enhancements to be triaged into sprint if PM ok. Thoughts?

dan: 70/30 is safe. We should also allow a single daily hotfix merge for critical customer fixes. Ops can manage the windows.

evan: Agree on the small-enhancer rule but add requirement: tests + feature-flag + post-deploy monitor dashboard. We had a bad rollout last time because a small change cascaded.

opsbot: Scheduled maintenance window: 2026-03-26T02:00Z - 2026-03-26T04:00Z for infra housekeeping. Not related to canary.

release-bot: Canary slot reserved: 2117772222-canary-1 on 2026-03-26T03:00Z. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.ai/quick-canary.

maria: Decision: two sprints, 70/30, small-enhancer fast-path (<=3h + tests + flag), daily hotfix slot for P0s. Weekly sync Mon 09:00 PT. Owners: dan (infra), evan (telemetry), maria (PM/comms).

dan: I'll add GH label "postlaunch-stabilize" and create the Jira board.

evan: I'll prepare dashboards per-customer and a canary checklist including canary thresholds and rollback steps.

maria: We'll re-evaluate after sprint 2; if stability holds, transition to regular roadmap.

dan: :thumbsup:

evan: :thumbsup:

maria: :thumbsup:
